clusters.rule: In user-facing prose - newsfragments, release notes and config.yml descriptions - write the Airflow concept as title-case "Dag"/"Dags", never all-caps "DAG"/"DAGs"; reserve all-caps DAG for code identifiers and quoted strings.
clusters.trigger: A newsfragment, release note or config.yml description: block adds prose containing "DAG" or "DAGs" outside backticks or a code identifier.

clusters.rule: Keep a PR scoped to the change its title and description claim: unrelated uv.lock churn must be reverted, an Alembic migration that fixes a pre-existing schema issue must go in its own PR, and a second independent feature must either be split out or added to the PR description with its own rationale and compatibility notes.
clusters.trigger: The diff contains uv.lock changes with no dependency bump in the description, an independent schema-fix migration alongside a feature migration, or a second unrelated feature (e.g. worker recycling added to a DAG-caching PR).

clusters.rule: Help text for CLI date arguments that filter runs by partition or logical date must state the exact semantics: whether the end bound is inclusive or exclusive (and what value covers a whole calendar period), and that the calendar day is derived from the UTC instant rather than the user's local or the timetable's timezone.
clusters.trigger: A CLI argument in cli_config.py / dag_command.py adds --start-date / --end-date (or another type=parsedate date filter) whose help text does not spell out inclusivity and the UTC-day interpretation.

clusters.rule: New or changed behaviour on a public API endpoint must be covered by tests asserting the new response, including the new validation error path and the changed default.
clusters.trigger: A bulk endpoint gains a validation guard, or a service method changes what an endpoint returns by default, without new or updated tests for those paths.

clusters.rule: Task-SDK client changelog entries belong in the Task-SDK changelog, not in the airflow-core RELEASE_NOTES.rst.
clusters.trigger: RELEASE_NOTES.rst gains a line mentioning task-sdk / Task SDK client inside an airflow-core section.

clusters.rule: A new config option introduced in a patch release must be declared in config.yml and explicitly called out in that minor version's upgrade notes.
clusters.trigger: A patch PR adds a key to config.yml, or documents a new [section] key_name, with no corresponding entry in the upgrade notes.

clusters.rule: Every locale skill file under .github/skills/airflow-translations/locales/ must declare that it extends the global rules in ../SKILL.md and that the locale file takes precedence on conflict.
clusters.trigger: A locale skill file (.github/skills/airflow-translations/locales/<lang>.md) is added or modified without a reference to ../SKILL.md and an explicit precedence statement.

clusters.rule: In a locale's do-not-translate list, mark only the bare Airflow noun (e.g. "Asset") as untranslatable; do not block compound phrases (e.g. "Asset Events") whose surrounding words the existing locale JSON already translates.
clusters.trigger: A locale skill file's do-not-translate list contains a multi-word phrase built around an Airflow term while the locale's JSON files translate the non-Airflow words of that phrase.

clusters.rule: Documentation for extensible Airflow interfaces (state backends, secrets backends, other plug points) must describe the contract and behaviour rather than enumerate concrete method signatures.
clusters.trigger: A .rst file adds a list-table or code-block of full method signatures (e.g. async def ...) for a pluggable backend or extension point.

clusters.rule: AIP skill SKILL.md files must anchor AIP URL detection to the Apache Confluence prefix https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/AIRFLOW rather than treating any https:// argument as the AIP URL.
clusters.trigger: A SKILL.md under .github/skills/aip-* describes AIP URL detection as "other https:// arguments are the AIP URL" with no cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/AIRFLOW anchor.

clusters.rule: Locale skill files must cross-reference the rationale already documented in airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/public/i18n/locales/<lang>/README.md when they consolidate that locale's translation conventions.
clusters.trigger: A locale skill file under .github/skills/airflow-translations/locales/ is created or updated with no reference to the in-tree i18n README for that locale.

clusters.rule: Docs examples showing regex filtering of asset partition keys must call .partition_key_pattern(), not .partition_key() (which is exact-match).
clusters.trigger: A docs example passes a regex string to .partition_key(.

clusters.rule: Documentation for a feature introduced in a specific Airflow version must get its own .. note:: block or subheader rather than being nested under a section that documents a different feature.
clusters.trigger: A diff adds documentation for a new feature (e.g. Resumable Tasks) inside an existing section covering a distinct feature (e.g. Deferred Operators).

clusters.rule: Airflow documentation must describe the current behaviour without comparing it to earlier versions; drop phrases like "no longer", "previously", "used to" and "as of version X".
clusters.trigger: Documentation prose adds "no longer", "previously", "used to", or "as of Airflow X.Y".

clusters.rule: Document task-state-store and asset-state-store values as JsonValue (any JSON-serialisable type), not as strings.
clusters.trigger: Docs describe a task store or asset store value type as "string"/"str" rather than JsonValue or JSON.

clusters.rule: Authentication documentation must not present the FAB Auth Manager as the default; the default auth manager in Airflow 3 is the Simple Auth Manager.
clusters.trigger: Docs or configuration examples imply the FAB Auth Manager is in use by default.

clusters.rule: Getting-started and quickstart documentation must cover both the uv-based install path and the standard pip + venv path.
clusters.trigger: The install quickstart section is added or rewritten covering only uv or only pip.

clusters.rule: Use a bugfix.rst newsfragment rather than significant.rst for internal fixes with no observable user-facing behaviour change, and omit the fragment entirely when there is no user impact.
clusters.trigger: A significant.rst newsfragment is added for an internal race-condition fix or scheduler-internal improvement with no API or behaviour change.

clusters.rule: A significant newsfragment describing a permission or endpoint change must name the surface precisely (e.g. "FastAPI UI /dags endpoint") to distinguish it from other endpoints sharing the same path.
clusters.trigger: A significant.rst newsfragment mentions /dags or another ambiguous path without saying whether it is the UI route or the public REST API endpoint.

clusters.rule: Do not set document.title from inside React components in the Airflow UI; the title is defined once in index.html.
clusters.trigger: A document.title assignment appears inside a useEffect in a .tsx file under the Airflow UI source tree.

clusters.rule: Tests for a cursor-paginated route must assert both boundaries: previous_cursor is null on the first page and next_cursor is null on the last.
clusters.trigger: A new cursor-pagination route is added without tests covering previous_cursor on page 1 and next_cursor on the final page.

clusters.rule: Assign a large dict to a named variable before passing it to Model.model_validate() rather than inlining the literal in the call.
clusters.trigger: Model.model_validate({...}) is called with a multi-key inline dict containing computed or conditional expressions.

clusters.rule: When a route handler writes the Refreshed-API-Token header that JWTReissueMiddleware also writes, add an inline comment explaining why they cannot collide.
clusters.trigger: response.headers["Refreshed-API-Token"] is assigned in a route handler that coexists with JWTReissueMiddleware.

clusters.rule: config.yml descriptions must not name internal database tables; describe the concept in user-facing terms instead.
clusters.trigger: A description: in config.yml references an internal table name such as "task_state rows" or "dag_run rows".

clusters.rule: Docstrings on overridable DAG-processing methods must state the conditions under which the default implementation does nothing.
clusters.trigger: A method in dag_processing/ intended for override has a docstring that omits its no-op conditions.

clusters.rule: A fix to an example DAG for a timezone or datetime bug must come with a regression test that imports the DAG under a non-UTC [core] default_timezone.
clusters.trigger: An example_dags/ file is modified to fix a datetime/timezone issue with no test exercising a non-UTC default_timezone.

clusters.rule: A significant change to triggerer behaviour must ship with a newsfragment.
clusters.trigger: The diff changes triggerer behaviour (new capability, protocol change, significant fix) with no file added under newsfragments/.

clusters.rule: Update the docstring when a method is decorated with @provider_info_cache so it describes the cached semantics rather than the former uncached helper's.
clusters.trigger: A docstring is moved from an uncached helper onto a @provider_info_cache-decorated method, or the decorator is added without revising the docstring.

clusters.rule: When adding an i18n key to en/common.json, seed the same English string into every other locale's common.json.
clusters.trigger: A key is added to ui/public/i18n/locales/en/common.json and no other locale's common.json is touched.

clusters.rule: Capitalise acronyms in translation strings as they are in English (JSON, DAG, API, UI, ID).
clusters.trigger: A locale JSON value introduces a well-known acronym in all-lowercase.

clusters.rule: An /* eslint-disable max-lines */ comment must be accompanied by an inline justification for why the file legitimately exceeds the limit.
clusters.trigger: /* eslint-disable max-lines */ is added with no explanatory comment on the same or the following line.

clusters.rule: Use Chakra semantic color tokens in `.tsx` component files; do not reference hardcoded colour-scale strings outside the designated theme/utils file.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a literal colour scale reference (e.g. `blue.500`, `green.300`) in a component instead of a semantic token.

clusters.rule: E2e helpers and assertions must wait for the UI to settle rather than reading immediately after an action: navigation helpers must wait for a key element to be visible before returning, and post-click assertions (e.g. pagination) must use `expect.poll()`.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `goto(`/`navigateTo*` helper with no subsequent `waitFor`/`toBeVisible`, or compares page content immediately after a navigation click without `expect.poll`.

clusters.rule: E2e page objects and specs must take the DAG under test from `testConfig.testDag.id`; do not hardcode a DAG ID, neither as a spec-level constant nor as a default parameter value on a page-object method.
clusters.trigger: diff adds `const DAG_ID = "example_bash_operator"` in `tests/e2e/specs/*.ts`, or a `tests/e2e/pages/*.ts` method with a default string argument such as `dagId: string = "example_bash_operator"`.

clusters.rule: E2e specs that assert on state produced by a DAG run must trigger the DAG and wait for `"success"` in a `test.beforeAll` block before running assertions.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `test.describe` block in `tests/e2e/specs/*.ts` asserting run-dependent state without a `beforeAll` that triggers the DAG and verifies its status.

clusters.rule: E2e tests must not contain conditional logic that lets them pass whether or not the feature works.
clusters.trigger: diff adds an `if (count > 0) { ... }` guard or similar short-circuit around the assertions in `tests/e2e/specs/*.ts`.

clusters.rule: In e2e page objects targeting an `InputWithAddon`, locate the field with `getByText(label)` plus `.locator('input')` rather than `getByRole('textbox', { name: ... })`.
clusters.trigger: diff adds `getByRole("textbox", { name: ... })` in a page object for a field rendered by `InputWithAddon`.

clusters.rule: A provider module path may only be added to the `test_providers_modules_should_have_tests` allowlist in the same PR that adds the referenced test file.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a path string to the project-structure allowlist without the corresponding test file in the same PR.

clusters.rule: Alembic stairway migration tests must include the failing revision ID in the failure message.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a loop over migration revisions calling `command.upgrade`/`downgrade` without re-raising or failing with the `revision_id` in the message.

clusters.rule: Tests asserting on a tag/stats dictionary that should be fully specified must assert full dict equality, not a series of per-key assertions.
clusters.trigger: diff replaces `assert tags == {...}` with individual `assert tags["key"] == ...` assertions.

clusters.rule: Prefer top-level `def test_*` functions over tiny one-scenario test classes in files whose dominant pattern is top-level functions.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a narrow new test class to a file where top-level test functions are the established pattern.

clusters.rule: Paginated bulk-action API endpoints must have a test that exercises multi-page traversal (e.g. `limit=1`) to prove the action applies across every page.
clusters.trigger: diff adds tests for a paginated bulk PATCH/POST endpoint with no `limit=1` case.

clusters.rule: New task-group / task-instance state-change API handlers must have unmocked integration tests covering upstream and downstream propagation, past/future run coverage and the deadlock/409 paths.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `TestPatch*TaskGroup`/`TestPatch*TaskInstance` class whose tests all mock the underlying state-transition method.

clusters.rule: Tests for endpoint parameters that accept several values (e.g. True/False/None filter flags) must be `@pytest.mark.parametrize`d, not folded into one assertion block.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a test function asserting several filter-param combinations sequentially in a single body.

clusters.rule: Consolidate multiple `session.flush()` calls in test setup into a single flush at the end, unless an earlier flush is required by a subsequent setup query.
clusters.trigger: Two or more `session.flush()` calls appear in the setup section of one test function or fixture.

clusters.rule: Guard performance-motivated ORM changes (e.g. replacing `session.merge()` with `session.add()`) with an `assert_queries_count()` assertion so a regression fails CI.
clusters.trigger: diff swaps `session.merge(` for `session.add(` on a `task_instance`/`dag_run` path with no accompanying `assert_queries_count`.

clusters.rule: Bugfix entries in `chart/RELEASE_NOTES.rst` must be a concise one-line title; the detailed explanation belongs in the PR, not the release note.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a multi-sentence bugfix entry to `chart/RELEASE_NOTES.rst`.

clusters.rule: When a Helm value is split into executor-specific keys (e.g. `workers.labels` into `workers.celery.labels` / `workers.kubernetes.labels`), document it as deprecated in favour of the per-executor keys — with an example for each new key — and never as a 'rename'.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a deprecation notice in chart docs, `NOTES.txt` or `_helpers.yaml` that says 'renamed to X' for a split value, or removes the worker example without adding one per new key.

clusters.rule: `chart/newsfragments/*.significant.rst` entries for breaking changes must enumerate every removed Helm value with its replacement as an explicit old-to-new mapping, not a prose summary.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `.significant.rst` newsfragment mentioning removed values or dropped executor support without listing the specific key mappings.

clusters.rule: Tests for `@operator_defaults` must include a case where the operator explicitly overrides the decorator's default (e.g. `retries=0` beating `@operator_defaults(retries=3)`).
clusters.trigger: diff adds `@operator_defaults` test cases that only cover the decorator supplying its value.

clusters.rule: DAG serialization test fixtures containing fields that are always emitted because their defaults come from `airflow.cfg` at parse time (e.g. `catchup`, `max_active_runs`, `max_active_tasks`) must carry an inline comment saying so.
clusters.trigger: diff adds or edits a serialization fixture including such fields with no explanatory comment.

clusters.rule: A test that takes the `caplog` fixture must assert on captured log output; if there is nothing to assert, remove `caplog` and its setup.
clusters.trigger: A test function accepts `caplog` but contains no assertion against `caplog.text` or `caplog.records`.

clusters.rule: Do not bundle unrelated tightening (e.g. adding `spec=` to an existing MagicMock) into a PR whose title describes a distinct bug fix; drop the hunk or call it out in the PR body.
clusters.trigger: diff modifies an existing `mock.MagicMock()` to add `spec=` in a file otherwise changed only for an unrelated fix.

clusters.rule: Docker Compose services under `airflow-e2e-tests/` must not set a fixed `container_name`, must address each other by service-name hostname, and must not publish host ports without a demonstrated external need.
clusters.trigger: diff adds `container_name:` or a host-port mapping to a service in a compose file under `airflow-e2e-tests/`.

clusters.rule: In `chart/RELEASE_NOTES.rst`, wrap every Helm values key reference in double RST backticks (e.g. ``workers.celery.nodeSelector``).
clusters.trigger: diff adds a line to `chart/RELEASE_NOTES.rst` containing a dotted Helm values path without surrounding double backticks.

clusters.rule: In `chart/values.yaml`, describe auto-generated config values as 'generated by default from `.Values.<helmPath>`' and point users at the Helm value, rather than calling the config key deprecated or the override the only option.
clusters.trigger: A values.yaml comment says a config key is 'deprecated' or 'only possible' via direct `config.*` override when the chart actually generates it from a Helm value.

clusters.rule: When a Helm config flag's behaviour depends on another value (e.g. `statsd_on` gated on `otelCollector.metricsEnabled`), document the dependency in both `values.yaml` and `values.schema.json`.
clusters.trigger: A conditional expression in the `config:` block of values.yaml references two or more `.Values` fields but only one carries an explanatory comment.

clusters.rule: The `KUSTOMIZE_OVERLAYS_FILES` group in `selective_checks.py` must include `^chart/templates/` and `^chart/files/`.
clusters.trigger: diff adds or edits `FileGroupForCi.KUSTOMIZE_OVERLAYS_FILES` without those patterns.

clusters.rule: Tests for Breeze CLI flag-pair rendering must include a flag that has both a short and a long alias, asserting the long form is the one emitted.
clusters.trigger: A test in `dev/breeze/tests/` for flag-rendering logic only covers flags with a single long form.

clusters.rule: Do not put implementation-detail comments in `chart/values.yaml`; comments there describe what the field controls, not template guard logic, schema mechanics or helper internals.
clusters.trigger: A values.yaml comment explains internal template or Helm helper behaviour rather than the field's user-facing effect.

clusters.rule: Release-tooling shell scripts under `dev/` must branch on `$(uname)` so both macOS (BSD `date`) and Linux (GNU `date`) syntax work.
clusters.trigger: A shell script in `dev/` uses GNU-only `date --utc` or BSD-only `date -v` with no OS check.

clusters.rule: New path-parsing or git-worktree logic in Breeze must be covered by unit tests for an absolute gitdir path, a relative gitdir path, and the non-worktree case.
clusters.trigger: A function reading `.git` file content or deriving paths from `AIRFLOW_ROOT_PATH` is added to `path_utils.py`/`shell_params.py` without those three cases.

clusters.rule: When invoking or documenting `prek` in Breeze code and messages, use `--hook-stage`, not `--stage`.
clusters.trigger: A prek invocation or instructional string under `dev/breeze/` uses `--stage`.

clusters.rule: Helm test coverage for deprecated-but-still-supported value overrides (e.g. `workers.keda.query`) must be kept when the executor or CRD that exercised them is removed; migrate the case to an equivalent supported executor instead of deleting it.
clusters.trigger: diff deletes a helm test parametrize case covering a value path still listed in the `NOTES.txt` deprecation notice.

clusters.rule: Helm tests for a given component must live in that component's established `test_<component>.py` file, not be spread across other files.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a test class for a component (e.g. `TestMetadataConnectionTplRendering`) to a file other than the component's dedicated test file.

clusters.rule: Where the Go SDK and the Python supervisor use different frame-size caps for the IPC channel, each side's constant must carry a doc comment explaining its value and why the two sides differ.
clusters.trigger: diff adds or changes a frame/buffer-size constant in `go-sdk/pkg/execution/` with no comment relating it to the Python cap.

clusters.rule: ADR documents must cite the actual function or method where the described behaviour lives; do not name a helper when the logic sits in the exported entry point.
clusters.trigger: diff adds or edits an ADR `.md` referencing a code symbol by name that does not match the real location.

clusters.rule: Source release tarballs built from the Java SDK must `export-ignore` binary wrapper artifacts such as `gradle-wrapper.jar`.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `git archive` invocation in a Gradle release task without a `.gitattributes` export-ignore for `gradle-wrapper.jar`.

clusters.rule: Public interfaces and classes in the Java/Kotlin SDK must carry KDoc/JavaDoc.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `public interface` or `public class` under `java-sdk/sdk/src/main/kotlin/` with no KDoc block.

clusters.rule: Provider `changelog.rst` entries must use sentence-case commit titles; lowercase openers and conventional-commit prefixes such as `fix:` are not acceptable.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a line to `providers/*/docs/changelog.rst` whose title starts with a lowercase word or a `fix:`/`feat:` prefix.

clusters.rule: A Trigger test that verifies one deadline path (e.g. `execution_deadline`) must set the other deadline (`end_time`) to a future value so exactly one timeout branch is exercised.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a Trigger unit test where both `end_time` and `execution_deadline` are already expired.

clusters.rule: Do not use `caplog` in Kubernetes/integration tests; capture logs with mocks instead.
clusters.trigger: diff adds `caplog` as a parameter or fixture to a test under `kubernetes-tests/`.

clusters.rule: When changing behaviour that existing tests cover, update the tests to cover both the new branch and the altered or removed one; do not leave assertions describing behaviour that no longer exists.
clusters.trigger: diff changes conditional logic in an operator without adding or updating tests for both sides of the condition.

clusters.rule: Amazon provider docstrings must append `(templated)` to the description of every parameter listed in `template_fields`.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `:param:` line in an Amazon provider operator, trigger or sensor for a field present in `template_fields` without the `(templated)` marker.

clusters.rule: Provider how-to RST docs must order lifecycle sections to follow the resource lifecycle: Create, Start, Stop, Update, Delete.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a section to a provider how-to doc out of lifecycle order.

clusters.rule: Avoid adding unit tests that only re-exercise paths an existing broader test already covers; prefer fewer, higher-value tests over branch-by-branch duplication.
clusters.trigger: diff adds several small test functions each covering a single branch already exercised as a sub-case of an existing test in the same file.

clusters.rule: In caplog-based trigger tests, call `caplog.set_level(...)` before invoking the method under test.
clusters.trigger: diff adds an `async def test_*` that asserts on `caplog.records`/`caplog.text` without a preceding `caplog.set_level`.

clusters.rule: Spark provider docs for K8s-API tracking must state that the worker's kube client is used for pod tracking and that the K8s path bypasses `ResumableJobMixin`, so a retry submits a fresh driver rather than reattaching.
clusters.trigger: diff adds or edits a Requirements/Caveats section for K8s-based Spark submission under `providers/apache/spark/docs/`.

clusters.rule: Spark provider documentation describing worker-crash and resubmission behaviour must mention that a non-idempotent job can conflict on resubmission, not only that compute is wasted.
clusters.trigger: diff adds prose about job resubmission under `providers/apache/spark/docs/` without mentioning idempotency conflicts.

clusters.rule: In system tests, set `AIRFLOW_CONN_*` environment variables and perform connection setup — including reads of `SystemTestContextBuilder` values — inside a `@task`-decorated function, never at DAG-parse scope.
clusters.trigger: diff adds `os.environ[...] = ...` or connection construction at module/DAG-definition scope in a system test file.

clusters.rule: System tests must mark each step of the task chain with its phase — setup, test body, teardown — following the pattern in canonical examples such as `example_sqs.py`.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `chain(...)` in a system test with no comments or naming distinguishing the phases.

clusters.rule: System tests must be run end-to-end locally before submission; reviewers reject system tests that have not been exercised.
clusters.trigger: diff adds or substantially modifies a file under `providers/*/tests/system/`.

clusters.rule: `pytest.raises(ClientError)` in provider tests must carry a `match=` asserting the specific AWS error code under test.
clusters.trigger: diff adds `pytest.raises(ClientError)` without `match=` in a provider unit test.

clusters.rule: Remove unused `moto` fixtures and their `mock_aws` imports from unit test modules that make no real AWS API calls.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a `@pytest.fixture` wrapping a hook in `mock_aws()` that no test in the module references.

clusters.rule: Notes and warnings in provider changelog RST must use the `.. note::` / `.. warning::` directive rather than plain prose.
clusters.trigger: A `docs/changelog.rst` diff adds a paragraph that reads as a note or warning without the directive.

clusters.rule: Documentation claims about KubernetesPodOperator deduplication or ambiguity prevention must be scoped to the specific code path where the guarantee actually holds (e.g. `get_or_create_pod`), not asserted end-to-end.
clusters.trigger: A provider docs RST diff claims 'no possibility of ambiguity failure' or equivalent absolute language about pod reconnect behaviour.

clusters.rule: New keyword arguments on `KubernetesPodOperator.__init__` (and other cncf.kubernetes operators) need a matching `:param name:` docstring entry describing the type; for `Callable` parameters the entry must name what each positional argument means.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a keyword argument to such an `__init__` with no corresponding `:param:` entry.

clusters.rule: When a parameter's behaviour is gated on a minimum Airflow version, its `:param:` docstring entry must state the constraint explicitly (e.g. "Only available for Airflow 3.3+").
clusters.trigger: A new operator parameter whose full behaviour requires Airflow >= X.Y is documented without the version constraint.

clusters.rule: Do not add a provider changelog release entry for a PR that changed only test files or non-functional `pyproject.toml` marker comments.
clusters.trigger: A provider `docs/changelog.rst` diff adds a version section for a PR whose changed files are all under `tests/` or are only `# use next version` comments.

clusters.rule: In Kubernetes-provider tests, set pod status with `V1PodStatus(...)` objects rather than plain dicts.
clusters.trigger: Test code assigns `pod.status = {"key": value}` instead of a `V1PodStatus` instance.

clusters.rule: Freeze time with `time_machine` in tests that compare timestamps or durations; do not derive expected values from `datetime.now()`/`utcnow()`.
clusters.trigger: A test calls `datetime.datetime.now()` or `utcnow()` to compute an expected duration or timestamp rather than using `@time_machine.travel`.

clusters.rule: In `SparkKubernetesOperator` pod-selection tests, keep `metadata.name` identical across all mock pods and set `deletion_timestamp` explicitly so each selection criterion is exercised independently.
clusters.trigger: A test for `find_spark_job`/`get_or_create_pod` builds mock pods with differing names or omits `deletion_timestamp`.

clusters.rule: Provider documentation that exposes a subset of an upstream library's capabilities must link the upstream capability list and state which features are not yet supported.
clusters.trigger: A provider `.rst` lists supported backends/integrations without referencing the upstream list or noting the gaps.

clusters.rule: Complete runnable DAGs in provider documentation must be pulled in with `.. exampleinclude::` from a tested file under `example_dags/`; `.. code-block:: python` is for fragments only.
clusters.trigger: A provider `.rst` contains a `.. code-block:: python` holding a full, runnable DAG.

clusters.rule: Mocks that stand in for a real interface must be specced — `MagicMock(spec=...)`, `spec_set=`, or `create_autospec` — including nested attributes; `MagicMock(autospec=True)` is a no-op keyword and does not spec anything.
clusters.trigger: A bare `MagicMock()` (or `MagicMock(autospec=True)`) substituted for a known type such as the Task SDK execution API `Client`, `RunContext`, `ToolsetTool`, or a credentials object, then given attributes the real type may not have

clusters.rule: Tests for `get_async_connection` with a custom `hook=` argument must cover both the `aget_connection` path and the sync `get_connection` fallback path.
clusters.trigger: A test exercising `get_async_connection(hook=...)` that asserts only on the async branch

clusters.rule: When a provider operator or hook gains a new documented parameter or changes its documented behaviour (auth types, supported options), update the class docstring and the matching provider RST guide under `providers/<name>/docs/` in the same PR.
clusters.trigger: A new `__init__` parameter or a changed `:param ...:` docstring list in a provider operator/hook with no corresponding edit to `providers/<name>/docs/operators/*.rst` or `providers/<name>/docs/connections/*.rst`

clusters.rule: In RST documentation, write version milestones as "Airflow version X.Y.Z", not a bare "version X.Y.Z".
clusters.trigger: An RST sentence containing `version <n>.<n>` without `Airflow` immediately before it

clusters.rule: Extract repeated `test_client.app.dependency_overrides[...]` setup into a shared fixture instead of duplicating it in each test method.
clusters.trigger: Several test methods in one class repeating the same `dependency_overrides` assignment block

clusters.rule: Give `timetable_type` a sensible default in the `DagModel` constructor so tests do not have to assign it on every instance.
clusters.trigger: Tests assigning `dag_model.timetable_type = ""` in setUp or individual test bodies

clusters.rule: Add a bullet to a provider's `changelog.rst` only when that provider's own source files change; a PR touching only another provider's tests gets no entry.
clusters.trigger: A new bullet in `providers/<name>/docs/changelog.rst` for a diff limited to test files of a different provider

clusters.rule: Place forward-looking compatibility notes in a provider changelog above the upcoming release section, never inside or below an already-published release block.
clusters.trigger: A `.. note::` or compatibility banner inserted into or after an existing versioned release block in `changelog.rst`

clusters.rule: Add new provider documentation as `.rst` files wired into the existing docs structure, not as standalone `.md` files.
clusters.trigger: A new `.md` file added under `providers/*/docs/`

clusters.rule: Name provider system test files after the existing files in the same system-test folder; do not append a `_system` suffix.
clusters.trigger: A new file under `providers/*/tests/system/` named `test_<service>_system.py`

clusters.rule: Document a hook's connection configuration behaviour in its docstring: which `extra` keys are supported and in what precedence order, and exactly when a keyless fallback such as Application Default Credentials applies versus when an explicit key is still required.
clusters.trigger: A hook connection-init or auth method that adds conditional key-file skipping or several `extra.get(...)` branches without a matching `:param ...:`/docstring description

clusters.rule: Provider documentation links must use the canonical `https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow-providers-<name>/` form; do not omit the `-providers-` segment.
clusters.trigger: An RST hyperlink to `https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow-<name>/`

clusters.rule: Each release version heading must appear exactly once in a provider's `changelog.rst`.
clusters.trigger: A version heading plus RST underline that already exists earlier in the same changelog file

clusters.rule: Target `@patch` at the symbol as the module under test imports it; patching a path the module never imports is a silent no-op.
clusters.trigger: `@patch("airflow.providers.<pkg>.hooks.<module>.<name>")` where `<name>` is not imported by that module

clusters.rule: Async hook tests must exercise the real method body with only the underlying I/O primitives patched, rather than patching the method under test itself.
clusters.trigger: `patch.object(hook, 'consume', side_effect=[...])` (or equivalent) replacing the very method the test claims to cover

clusters.rule: Provider unit tests must build `Connection` fixtures with the provider's own `conn_type`, not a generic type such as `http`.
clusters.trigger: A test under `providers/*/tests/` creating a `Connection(conn_type="http")` for a hook that declares its own `conn_type`

clusters.rule: Use proper RestructuredText footnote syntax in provider docs rather than plain bracketed numbers like `[1]`.
clusters.trigger: A `[N]` reference in `providers/*/docs/*.rst` that is not a real RST footnote or citation

clusters.rule: Adding deferrable mode to a provider operator requires both an update to that operator's RST docs page and a `providers/<pkg>/newsfragments/<pr>.feature.rst` newsfragment.
clusters.trigger: A diff adding `self.defer(...)` to a provider operator with no newsfragment file and/or no operator docs update

clusters.rule: An `AirflowPlugin` subclass docstring must describe only the events the plugin actually registers and handles.
clusters.trigger: A plugin docstring claiming to handle event types (e.g. DAG run events) that the plugin body does not implement

clusters.rule: Assertions on `trigger.serialize()` must check that the result is a tuple, that the class path string matches the trigger's `__module__`/`__name__`, and that the full kwargs dict is as expected.
clusters.trigger: A test destructuring `trigger.serialize()` without verifying the tuple type or the fully-qualified class path

clusters.rule: Update `tests/unit/openlineage/plugins/test_manager.py` whenever the OpenLineage extractor manager's branching changes.
clusters.trigger: A change to `openlineage/extractors/manager.py` with no corresponding test change

clusters.rule: Assert a mock was called exactly once (`assert_called_once()` or a `call_count` check) before inspecting `call_args`.
clusters.trigger: Access to `mock_*.call_args` with no preceding call-count assertion

clusters.rule: Do not assert on log output with `caplog`; assert on observable behaviour or return values instead.
clusters.trigger: A test importing or using pytest's `caplog` fixture to assert on logged messages

clusters.rule: Tests for SecretsMasker exception redaction must traverse the whole exception chain: attach a secret via `__cause__`/`__context__` and assert it is redacted, and include a cross-attribute cycle (`exc1.__cause__ = exc2; exc2.__context__ = exc1`) to prove the visited-set guard holds.
clusters.trigger: A redaction test that only inspects `exc.args`, or a circular-chain test that covers only same-attribute cycles

clusters.rule: Task SDK documentation examples showing an async `@task` function must include the enclosing `@dag`-decorated wrapper so the snippet is a runnable DAG file.
clusters.trigger: An `.rst`/`.md` example defining an `@task` function and calling it at module level with no `@dag` function around it

clusters.rule: The `check_provide_session_kwargs` hook tests must cover the bypass path where an allowlist entry is removed or newly added, not only where an existing entry's count is loosened.
clusters.trigger: Tests for `_expand_for_allowlist_edits` exercising only the increased-count case

clusters.rule: Pre-commit hook tests must pass `Path.resolve()`d paths so they match the production hook's path normalisation.
clusters.trigger: A hook test passing a raw path where the production code calls `Path(f).resolve()` before comparing

clusters.rule: When a class reads an Airflow config value to supply an argument default, add a regression test that changes that config key before constructing the object and asserts the default is picked up.
clusters.trigger: An `__init__` reading `conf.get*` for a default with no test that constructs the class after modifying that section/key

clusters.rule: When renaming a message class in `task-sdk/.../execution_time/comms.py`, update the hardcoded message-type allowlists in `airflow-core/tests/unit/dag_processing/test_processor.py` and `airflow-core/tests/unit/jobs/test_triggerer_job.py` in the same PR.
clusters.trigger: A renamed `ToTask`/`ToSupervisor` message class with no corresponding edit to the allowlists in those two core test files

clusters.rule: When a Task SDK API method queries only the metadata database and deliberately skips secrets backends (e.g. `Variable.keys()` versus `Variable.get()`), document the asymmetry and its reason in a `.. note::` block in the docstring.
clusters.trigger: A new listing method in `task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/definitions/variable.py` with no note about secrets-backend exclusion

clusters.rule: Size-limit warnings and API error messages in task-SDK execution code must name the worker-side `[workers] state_store_backend` option as the remedy, using the same section name in the asset-store warning and the API errors.
clusters.trigger: A size-limit warning or HTTP error in task-sdk execution code naming a `[state_store] backend` option

clusters.rule: When client-level exception translation replaces an existing error path, keep end-to-end coverage at the supervisor level: replace the removed `test_supervisor.py` test with one asserting the new exception propagates from `ActivitySubprocess.start()`/`supervise` and the child process is killed.
clusters.trigger: A diff deleting a test from `task-sdk/tests/task_sdk/execution_time/test_supervisor.py` while adding the equivalent coverage only in `tests/task_sdk/api/test_client.py`

clusters.rule: Tests that keep a task subprocess alive to exercise signal delivery must bound their worst case to tens of seconds; do not write operator bodies like `for i in range(1000): sleep(1)`.
clusters.trigger: A test operator whose `execute` sleeps in a loop with a worst-case total well beyond a minute

clusters.rule: A regression test for a new `sys.exit(...)` inside `run()` must assert more than `SystemExit(1)`: it must also verify `on_failure_callback`, the `on_task_instance_failed` listener and `email_on_failure` still fire for the failed task instance.
clusters.trigger: A task-runner test asserting only `pytest.raises(SystemExit)` or an exit code for a failure path introduced by a new `sys.exit()`

clusters.rule: A comment or docstring that tells the reader to run a benchmark or helper script must name an entrypoint that exists in the tree (e.g. under `dev/`); otherwise add the script in the same PR or drop the instruction.
clusters.trigger: A comment or docstring pointing at a `dev/...` script or other repo entrypoint that is not present in the repository

clusters.rule: Hand-written lists inside `.github/` that mirror repository state (the provider inventory in issue templates, locale/namespace inventories in agent SKILL.md files) must be generated or validated by a prek/pre-commit hook rather than maintained by hand
clusters.trigger: A PR adds a manually enumerated list of providers, locales, or i18n namespaces to `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml` or `.github/skills/**/SKILL.md` without a corresponding hook entry in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`

clusters.rule: A new pre-commit hook's `files:` pattern must be narrowed to exactly the distributions and subpackages the rule applies to; never a bare `\.py$` or a whole-distribution glob
clusters.trigger: A new `- id:` block in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` uses `files: \.py$` or a broad `^providers/<dist>/(src|tests)/.*\.py$` for a check that only holds in part of that tree

clusters.rule: The version dropdown in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/1-airflow_bug_report.yml` must list only currently released, non-yanked versions; a yanked release is rolled back until `main` is bumped to its replacement
clusters.trigger: A PR adds or leaves a version string in the bug report template's `options:` list for a release that has been yanked or not yet cut

clusters.rule: Adding a new UI translation locale requires an identified, dev-list-confirmed owner recorded in `.github/CODEOWNERS` and a locale guideline file at `.github/skills/airflow-translations/locales/<code>.md`
clusters.trigger: A PR adds a new `airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/public/i18n/locales/<code>/` directory or CODEOWNERS entry without a dev@airflow.apache.org thread establishing owners and without the matching locale guideline file

clusters.rule: Do not add hand-written documentation pages that enumerate REST API endpoints or their schemas; the auto-generated `stable-rest-api-ref` page already publishes them
clusters.trigger: A new `.rst` file under `airflow-core/docs/` documents an API surface (endpoints, request/response shapes) that is already generated from the OpenAPI spec

clusters.rule: A new provider-governance policy section in `PROVIDERS.rst` must state its applicability to already-existing providers - either that it applies only to providers created after the governing AIP's approval date, or how existing providers are transitioned
clusters.trigger: A PR adds a governance section (stewardship, lifecycle, ownership requirements) to `PROVIDERS.rst` stating requirements without scoping them to new versus existing providers

clusters.rule: Locale guideline files under `.github/skills/airflow-translations/locales/` must use the same heading format as the existing ones - the language name plus the locale code only, e.g. `# Thai (th)`
clusters.trigger: A new `locales/<code>.md` file opens with a descriptive heading such as `# Thai (th) Translation Guidelines for Apache Airflow` instead of `# Thai (th)`

clusters.rule: A locale guideline file adapted from another locale's document must carry over every glossary term from the source, including deliberately untranslated ones such as `Dag ID`
clusters.trigger: A new or updated `locales/<code>.md` glossary omits terms that the locale document it was derived from lists

clusters.rule: In translation guidelines, the keep-in-English term list applies only to CamelCase code/class identifiers quoted verbatim as code (`TaskInstance`, `DagRun`, `Triggerer`); when the same concepts appear as UI labels they must follow the wording already in that locale's `i18n/locales/<code>/*.json`
clusters.trigger: A locale guideline file lists `TaskInstance`, `DagRun` or similar CamelCase identifiers under a blanket keep-in-English rule without distinguishing code identifiers from UI labels

clusters.rule: Prose in docs, newsfragments, release notes and UI strings must use the Airflow 3 spellings of core nouns - `Dag`, `Dags`, `Dag run`, `Dag files`, `Dag bundles`, `Dag Processor`, `API Server` - never `DAG`, `DAGs`, `DAG processor` or `webserver`; generic concept words stay lowercase unless they name an actual class
clusters.trigger: A `.rst` docs page, newsfragment, `RELEASE_NOTES.rst` bullet, changelog entry or translated UI string spells the term `DAG`/`DAGs`, uses `webserver` or `DAG processor`, or capitalises a generic concept noun that is not a class name

clusters.rule: `uv.lock` changes in a PR must match that PR's code diff; regenerate the lockfile against fresh `main` to strip rebase artefacts such as unrelated extras or dependency removals
clusters.trigger: A PR's `uv.lock` diff adds or removes dependencies (e.g. dropping `langchain-openai` from an extra) that nothing in the PR's source changes touches

clusters.rule: When docs enumerate a feature's parameters, each bullet must name the exact keyword argument in double backticks (``reference``, ``interval``, ``callback``) and the stated mandatory/optional counts must match the real signature
clusters.trigger: A docs page lists parameters as capitalised prose words (`Reference:`, `Interval:`, `Callback Kwargs:`) or claims a number of mandatory parameters that disagrees with the constructor signature

clusters.rule: A `.feature.rst` newsfragment must state what the new API does for users, not the internal defect it fixes
clusters.trigger: A newsfragment sentence is phrased as "... to fix <internal component/behaviour>" instead of describing the capability the change adds

clusters.rule: A `.significant.rst` newsfragment that ticks the Behaviour-change or Code-interface-change checkbox must spell out the delta in prose: "Previously it worked as X, now it works as Y" / "Previously the interface was X, now it is Y"
clusters.trigger: A `.significant.rst` file marks `[x] Behaviour changes` or `[x] Code interface changes` but contains no before/after explanation of what changed

clusters.rule: A significant newsfragment describing an observability or process-management change must add the operator-visible impact and migration step (dashboards built on the old Gauge must move to Histogram aggregations; how to roll-restart the api-server on Kubernetes)
clusters.trigger: A `.significant.rst` describes an internal representation or process change (metric instrument type, uvicorn worker/restart model) without saying what existing deployments must do about it

clusters.rule: Do not add a newsfragment for a documentation-only change; a `.doc.rst` fragment for a pure docs update is overkill
clusters.trigger: A PR whose diff touches only files under `docs/` also adds a file under `airflow-core/newsfragments/`

clusters.rule: In `multi-team.rst`, feature-specific sections belong above the concluding multi-team architecture diagram, which is meant to end the page
clusters.trigger: A new section is appended after the `multi_team_arch_diagram.png` image block in `airflow-core/docs/core-concepts/multi-team.rst`

clusters.rule: Architecture docs must say the scheduler reads serialized Dags from the metadata database and needs no direct Dag bundle access, and must not assert that another component (e.g. the triggerer) accesses bundles directly without verifying it
clusters.trigger: A docs diff enumerates which Airflow components require access to Dag bundles or Dag files

clusters.rule: `curl` examples in the docs must percent-encode reserved characters in the query string (`%7C` for `|`, `%5E` for `^`) or use `curl --data-urlencode`, so the example runs when copied verbatim
clusters.trigger: A `.. code-block:: bash` block adds a curl invocation whose URL query string contains a raw `|`, `^`, or other RFC 3986 reserved character

clusters.rule: A language-SDK docs page that documents log forwarding must also document the configuration the SDK already reads for it - for the Java SDK, `AIRFLOW__LOGGING__LOGGING_LEVEL` and `AIRFLOW__LOGGING__NAMESPACE_LEVELS`
clusters.trigger: A new Logging section under `airflow-core/docs/authoring-and-scheduling/language-sdks/` lists the integration artifacts but has no subsection on setting log levels

clusters.rule: A new row in `extra-packages-ref.rst` must describe exactly the component types the provider ships (hooks, triggers, queue providers, operators); do not write "hooks and operators" for a provider that defines no operators
clusters.trigger: A diff adds a row to the extras table in `airflow-core/docs/extra-packages-ref.rst` whose description does not match the components actually defined in the corresponding provider package

clusters.rule: A PR's title and description must describe the scope actually present in the diff; a documentation/CI/repo-metadata-only change must not be titled as a CLI or behaviour fix
clusters.trigger: PR title or description claims a code/CLI behaviour change but the diff touches only docs, CI configuration, or repo metadata

clusters.rule: Do not describe the Execution API as an "internal" API; describe it as an API for use by Airflow itself rather than third-party callers, because it is deliberately reachable from outside the deployment
clusters.trigger: Security or API documentation introduces the Execution API with the word "internal", or implies it is not exposed outside the deployment boundary

clusters.rule: Do not shorten ILIKE performance-warning descriptions in filter_param_factory docstrings; the explicit version explaining that `ILIKE '%term%'` prevents B-tree indexes and that prefix_pattern is preferred is required to guide operators on large tables
clusters.trigger: Performance note in filter_param_factory description shortened or replaced with an abbreviated form that omits the ILIKE expansion and index guidance

clusters.rule: OpenAPI HTTP exception description strings within the same route file must consistently either all end with a period or none do
clusters.trigger: create_openapi_http_exception_doc([...]) call where some description strings end with '.' and others do not within the same file

clusters.rule: Remove TODO comments that document conclusions of already-completed investigations; if the conclusion is 'no easy way to achieve this', delete the comment rather than leaving it in code

clusters.rule: Error messages that cite 'manually triggered' as the reason logical_date is None must also cover asset-triggered DAG runs, which equally have logical_date=None
clusters.trigger: error message string containing 'manually triggered' adjacent to a logical_date is None check on a DagRun

clusters.rule: Config entries in `config.yml` must document the meaning of all special sentinel values (e.g. `0` meaning "disabled" or "unlimited") in the `description` field
clusters.trigger: A new config key with a numeric `default` of `0` (or another sentinel) is added to `config.yml` without the `description` explaining what `0` means

clusters.rule: A config `description` in `config.yml` must not reference Airflow features or model fields that do not exist at HEAD in the same PR
clusters.trigger: A new config key's `description` mentions a field name or feature (e.g. `TaskInstanceDTO.language`) that is not present in the codebase in the same PR

clusters.rule: In example DAGs, inject context values via named `@task` parameters (e.g. `def load(asset_state):`) rather than capturing them from `**context`
clusters.trigger: An example DAG `@task` function signature uses `**context` and then accesses `context["asset_state"]`, `context["task_state"]`, or similar named keys

clusters.rule: When renaming an example DAG file or model, rename the corresponding test file and all test class names in the same commit; do not leave stale `*State` names in files that now test `*Store` semantics
clusters.trigger: A PR renames an example DAG (e.g. `example_task_state` -> `example_task_store`) but the matching test file path or class name still contains the old identifier

clusters.rule: Example DAGs in `airflow-core/src/airflow/example_dags/` that target the current `main` branch (Airflow 3.1+) must not include `try/except ImportError` compatibility shims for older Airflow versions
clusters.trigger: An example DAG file adds a `try: from airflow.sdk import X / except ImportError: from airflow.utils... import X` block

clusters.rule: When a bug-fix to an example DAG is motivated by a specific config scenario (e.g. non-UTC `[core] default_timezone`), extend `tests/unit/always/test_example_dags.py` to cover that DAG under the triggering config
clusters.trigger: A commit changes `start_date` or timezone handling in an example DAG file without adding or modifying a corresponding test in `test_example_dags.py`

clusters.rule: A cross-version compatibility test must drive the real entry path that builds the workload, not call the trigger's `run()` directly with hand-built kwargs
clusters.trigger: A test named `*_compat` / `*_32x_compat` instantiates the trigger and awaits `run()` itself, while the production path reaches `run()` only after a workload-construction gate

clusters.rule: Emit datetime attributes in OpenTelemetry span attribute dicts as RFC3339/ISO8601 strings, not raw Python datetime reprs or UNIX integer timestamps
clusters.trigger: attributes["airflow.*date*"] = str(some_datetime) where str() of a datetime does not produce ISO8601 format, or a raw timestamp integer is used

clusters.rule: When adding `__repr__`, `__str__`, or `serialize()` to serialization sentinel classes (e.g. `ArgNotSet`), add a focused unit test asserting the returned string is stable and that subclasses produce distinct output
clusters.trigger: New `__repr__`, `__str__`, or `serialize()` methods added to a serialization sentinel/singleton class in `airflow-core/src/airflow/serialization/` without a corresponding unit test

clusters.rule: Backward-compat fallback code in triggers that reads from old serialized state must include a comment stating in which Airflow version the fallback can be removed (once no pre-upgrade in-flight triggers remain)
clusters.trigger: A trigger adds a fallback branch for pre-upgrade serialized state without a `# TODO: remove in X.Y` or similar comment explaining the removal condition

clusters.rule: Changes to task-group click/navigation behaviour in the Grid view must come with a Playwright regression case in the dag-grid-view spec
clusters.trigger: A component under airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/src/layouts/Details/Grid changes click or navigation behaviour of task groups with no corresponding Playwright spec update

clusters.rule: Build documentation links from the shared docs-URL helper (src/utils/docs.ts); do not hard-code the stable-docs base URL in component files
clusters.trigger: The literal 'https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/stable' appears in a .ts/.tsx file other than the dedicated docs-URL utility

clusters.rule: New custom filter hooks in the UI must ship with unit tests covering their state transitions (adding/removing values, mode toggles at threshold boundaries)
clusters.trigger: A new useXxxFilter hook is added under airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/src without a corresponding unit test file

clusters.rule: Log e2e teardown failures at console.warn, not console.debug, so CI surfaces residual state left behind by a run
clusters.trigger: An e2e teardown file downgrades a failure log from console.warn to console.debug

clusters.rule: Playwright page objects must not wrap visibility/state checks in try/catch (or `.catch(() => false)`); use web-first assertions such as expect(el).toBeVisible()/toBeHidden() and let failures propagate
clusters.trigger: A Playwright page-object method wraps isVisible()/isEnabled() in a try/catch returning false, or uses .catch(() => false), to handle a conditionally rendered element

clusters.rule: Do not use page.waitForLoadState('networkidle') in Playwright tests; wait on an explicit UI condition instead
clusters.trigger: A Playwright test or page object calls waitForLoadState('networkidle')

clusters.rule: Set a shared e2e timeout once via testInfo.setTimeout() in beforeEach rather than repeating test.setTimeout() in every test of a describe block
clusters.trigger: Multiple tests in the same describe block each call test.setTimeout() with the same value

clusters.rule: E2e specs for sort, filter and pagination features must assert the resulting data order or content, not merely that the control is visible or opens

clusters.rule: When testing SQLite-specific OperationalError handling, pass a real sqlite3.OperationalError as `orig` so the implementation's `e.orig.args[0]` inspection exercises the real shape
clusters.trigger: A test mocks sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError with a plain string as the orig argument where the implementation reads e.orig.args[0]

clusters.rule: New FastAPI endpoint tests that fetch collections must wrap the request in assert_queries_count so N+1 regressions from a missing eager load are caught
clusters.trigger: A new test exercises a FastAPI route returning a collection (assets, DAGs, task instances) with no assert_queries_count context manager

clusters.rule: A shared pytest fixture that mutates the execution API `lifespan.registry` must remove its override after yield
clusters.trigger: A pytest fixture wider than function scope calls lifespan.registry.register_value(...) with no cleanup after yield

clusters.rule: Execution API TI state-transition tests must cover both the idempotent same-state path (200) and the conflicting non-running state path (409) as separate explicit cases
clusters.trigger: A test covers an idempotent TI state update but the test file has no adjacent case asserting a mismatched state returns 409

clusters.rule: Heartbeat endpoint tests must assert that the fast-path UPDATE fired (or that the SELECT FOR UPDATE fallback did not) rather than counting total UPDATE statements against task_instance

clusters.rule: Coordinate concurrency tests deterministically with threading.Barrier/Event; do not use time.sleep() or randomised delays to create the timing window a race needs

clusters.rule: When test ordering within a class matters because conf_vars interacts with provider config layers, express it with pytest.mark.order instead of relying on file order

clusters.rule: Changes to DagBag/DagFileProcessorProcess file discovery must be covered by a test asserting whether extension-less files are still parsed

clusters.rule: Tests for DagFileProcessorProcess log forwarding must exercise _get_target_loggers and _create_log_forwarder rather than mocking start() and asserting a kwarg was passed
clusters.trigger: A DAG-processor log-routing test mocks DagFileProcessorProcess.start and asserts only that a kwarg is present

clusters.rule: Keep imports at module scope in test files; do not add stdlib, concurrent.futures or SQLAlchemy imports inside test functions or nested helpers
clusters.trigger: A diff adds an import statement inside a function or nested def body in a test file

clusters.rule: Scheduler tests for the TI adopt-failure metric must pass an explicit executor whose try_adopt_task_instances returns all TIs unresumed instead of relying on the ambient default executor

clusters.rule: Tests for dag.clear(only_new=True) must also pin the combined only_new=True plus task_ids= behaviour (error or precedence)

clusters.rule: Mocks standing in for Airflow or provider classes must be spec'd (MagicMock(spec=...) or create_autospec) so signature drift against the real class fails the test

clusters.rule: OTEL protocol-resolution parametrization must include a case where OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL overrides the generic OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL
clusters.trigger: A parametrize block for OTEL exporter protocol resolution lacks a case combining both the generic and the traces-specific env var

clusters.rule: Do not assert a hard-coded total plugin count in plugin-manager tests; assert the specific presence or deduplication behaviour under test

clusters.rule: Assert serialization truncation using the exported TRUNCATE_PREFIX/TRUNCATE_SUFFIX constants, not a loose substring check

clusters.rule: Wrap tests that call config-reading functions (e.g. resolve_state_backend()) in a conf_vars context manager instead of depending on ambient global config
clusters.trigger: A test calls an Airflow config-reading function without a conf_vars({...}) context manager

clusters.rule: Write all code comments in English, including in test files

clusters.rule: In Helm chart documentation say values files 'override' (not 'overwrite') the defaults, matching the chart's mergeOverwrite helper semantics

clusters.rule: Document the Breeze k8s workflow as `breeze k8s deploy-cluster --rebuild-base-image`, not the two-step build-k8s-image plus upload-k8s-image sequence
