clusters.rule: Every new parameter added to chart/values.yaml must also be declared in chart/values.schema.json
clusters.trigger: A key is added to values.yaml with no corresponding entry in values.schema.json

clusters.rule: Do not restate a default inside a values.schema.json description when the schema already declares it in a sibling `default` field
clusters.trigger: A values.schema.json description ends with 'Defaults to <X>.' where X is also given in the default field

clusters.rule: When the chart moves a value to a component-scoped path (ingress.enabled to ingress.apiServer.enabled), update the existing Helm tests to the new path instead of deleting them
clusters.trigger: A Helm test using the old broad values path is deleted when a component-scoped path is introduced

clusters.rule: Refer to the mypy distribution as apache_airflow_mypy / airflow_mypy.plugins in release docs and config examples; never as apache_airflow.mypy or airflow.mypy.plugins
clusters.trigger: A twine upload glob uses apache_airflow.mypy-, or a mypy plugins= line reads airflow.mypy.plugins

clusters.rule: In Breeze's global_constants.py, DEFAULT_POSTGRES_VERSION must be the oldest supported version in the list, not the newest
clusters.trigger: DEFAULT_POSTGRES_VERSION is set from the last entry of CURRENT_POSTGRES_VERSIONS rather than the first

clusters.rule: When a new ADR supersedes part of an earlier one, add a 'Superseded in part by ADR NNNN' note to the older ADR's Status section
clusters.trigger: A new ADR changes decisions from an older ADR without updating the older ADR's Status section

clusters.rule: Helm template tests must cover the edge cases, not just the happy path: multiple map entries for templated annotations, and unset/null plus boundary values (e.g. 0) for conditionally rendered fields
clusters.trigger: A Helm test asserts only a single annotation key for an airflow.tplDict-rendered map, or covers only the enabled/set case of a conditionally rendered value

clusters.rule: A provider howto .rst page must describe the operator's typical use case, not just literalinclude an example and link the vendor API reference
clusters.trigger: A new providers/*/docs/operators/*.rst consists only of literalinclude blocks plus a Reference link to vendor documentation

clusters.rule: A change that silently alters which driver, backend or default an existing provider user gets must add an entry to that provider's docs/changelog.rst in the same PR
clusters.trigger: A hook rewrites a connection URI drivername, swaps a client library, or changes a default with no corresponding providers/<name>/docs/changelog.rst entry

clusters.rule: When a system-test example moves from Jinja xcom_pull syntax to task.output, keep the old Jinja form as an inline comment
clusters.trigger: A system-test example replaces a '{{ task_instance.xcom_pull(...) }}' expression with <task>.output without leaving the old form as a comment

clusters.rule: Every [START howto_...] / [END howto_...] marker added to a system-test example must be referenced from the corresponding docs .rst
clusters.trigger: A [START howto_<name>] marker is added under tests/system/ with no matching literalinclude or reference in the docs directory

clusters.rule: Use @tenacity retry decorators, not time.sleep(), to handle transient waits and races in provider system tests and cleanup helpers
clusters.trigger: A system-test helper or cleanup function calls time.sleep() to wait for an async resource state

clusters.rule: Tests for AWS operator-link persistence must supply a context dict containing ti directly rather than switching on do_xcom_push, keeping UI-link behaviour decoupled from XCom return-value behaviour
clusters.trigger: A test sets do_xcom_push=True in order to exercise _persist_cloudwatch_link or a similar link-persistence method

clusters.rule: Put non-user-facing entries (internal tooling, build configuration, CI) in the hidden section of a provider changelog, not in a visible section such as Misc
clusters.trigger: A provider changelog.rst adds an internal PR entry (build config, CI tooling) under a visible section

clusters.rule: Sensor and trigger docstrings must name the granularity actually waited on: a sensor that waits for a Task Instance must say Task Instance, not DAG Run
clusters.trigger: A :param or docstring description in a sensor/trigger says 'DAG Run' where the wait target is a Task Instance, or vice versa

clusters.rule: Write provider changelog entries as plain user-facing prose: strip conventional-commit prefixes such as 'feat(...)', name no internal tooling (Dependabot), and state the concrete change (e.g. 'Bump aiohttp>=3.14.0')
clusters.trigger: A changelog entry starts with a conventional-commit prefix or mentions dependabot instead of describing the user-visible change

clusters.rule: SparkSubmitHook docstrings must keep `master` and `deploy_mode` as distinct parameters; do not collapse them into a phrase like 'YARN cluster'
clusters.trigger: A SparkSubmitHook docstring refers to 'YARN cluster' or otherwise merges the master and deploy_mode concepts

clusters.rule: Spell out full operator class names (KubernetesPodOperator) in provider changelogs and user-facing docs instead of internal abbreviations (KPO, KJO)
clusters.trigger: A changelog or docs .rst references an operator by an abbreviation rather than its class name

clusters.rule: Update a method's docstring when its caching or reload semantics change (e.g. from load-once to conditional reload)
clusters.trigger: A method's logic changes its execution frequency (a _config_loaded flag is bypassed) while the docstring still describes the old once-per-instance semantics

clusters.rule: Keep asserted log messages in tests identical to the strings the production code emits; do not change the expected string without changing the log call
clusters.trigger: A test asserts a caplog.text substring that does not match the string passed to self.log.* in the corresponding production code

clusters.rule: Provider documentation for an enum-valued operator parameter (e.g. on_finish_action) must enumerate every valid value with its exact state-transition semantics
clusters.trigger: A docs .rst lists only a subset of the valid values for an enum-type operator parameter without noting the omission

clusters.rule: Do not use pytest's `caplog` fixture in provider tests; capture the logger directly or assert on observable behaviour instead
clusters.trigger: `caplog` appears as a fixture argument in a test function under `providers/**/tests/`

clusters.rule: Do not await real `asyncio.sleep` durations in trigger unit tests; patch `asyncio.sleep` or use `asyncio.wait_for` to assert the trigger has not completed
clusters.trigger: `asyncio.sleep` with a literal float/int appears inside a test function in `providers/**/tests/**/triggers/test_*.py`

clusters.rule: A parameter's documented semantics must match what the code actually does with it: whether the value overrides, is appended to or merged with an underlying default; what the real fallback is when it is unset; and how much the code actually validates. Fix whichever side is wrong - reword the docstring, or make the implementation pass the value conditionally so the documented fallback really applies
clusters.trigger: A `:param:` docstring, RST page or OpenAPI query-parameter description states override/append/merge semantics, a fallback ("if None, the connection's project id is used"), or a validation scope that the implementation does not actually provide - e.g. the kwarg is passed unconditionally so the spec-file default can never apply, or `build_ordering()` supports a single field while the description says comma-separated

clusters.rule: When adding a row to the operator comparison table in a provider's `docs/operators/index.rst`, also update the operator count stated in the surrounding prose and add the matching descriptive paragraph
clusters.trigger: A new `* -` row is added to the operators table in `providers/**/docs/operators/index.rst` while the "N operators" sentence above it is unchanged

clusters.rule: In `AIRFLOW_CONN_*` examples in the common.ai quickstart, express `extra` as a nested JSON object rather than a JSON-serialised string
clusters.trigger: An `AIRFLOW_CONN_` shell export in provider docs sets `extra` to a quoted, escaped JSON string instead of a plain nested object

clusters.rule: Keep `provider.yaml` field descriptions in step with the schema they describe; drop wording that refers to connection fields or parameters that no longer exist
clusters.trigger: A `description:` value in `provider.yaml` names a field that is absent from the same connection-type block

clusters.rule: Example DAGs must be plain, self-contained and copy-pasteable: do not import helpers shared across example DAG files, and do not wrap optional-dependency imports in `try`/`except ImportError`
clusters.trigger: A file under `providers/**/example_dags/*.py` imports a helper defined in another example/support module, or guards an import with `try: import ... except ImportError`

clusters.rule: Never hand-edit generated files; change the source of truth and regenerate in the same commit - `get_provider_info.py` comes from `provider.yaml` via `prek run update-providers-build-files`, and the task-SDK `datamodels/_generated.py` comes from the Execution API OpenAPI schema
clusters.trigger: A diff edits `providers/**/get_provider_info.py` or `task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/api/datamodels/_generated.py` by hand, or edits a `provider.yaml` without the matching regenerated `get_provider_info.py`

clusters.rule: Keep provider `changelog.rst` entries to a single terse statement of the user-visible change; no methodology notes, PR narration, or "add tests for ..." clauses
clusters.trigger: A changelog line contains parenthetical test-coverage, refactor-rationale or methodology text

clusters.rule: A changelog `.. note::` about minimum Airflow version must not claim the release requires a newer Airflow than it does when the provider still runs on older versions and only conditionally activates the new feature
clusters.trigger: A `changelog.rst` note states the provider *requires* Airflow X.Y while the code activates the feature behind a version guard

clusters.rule: Refer to Airflow's metrics integration generically (statsd and OpenTelemetry) in documentation; do not describe it as "statsd" only
clusters.trigger: Docs or comments describe Airflow metrics/observability exclusively as statsd with no mention of OTel

clusters.rule: Tests for a validation or safety helper must include the exact call signature the production operator uses (e.g. `allowed_types=DEFAULT_ALLOWED_TYPES`), not only synthetic argument combinations
clusters.trigger: New tests for a validation function cover argument combinations that the owning operator never produces, leaving the operator's real code path untested

clusters.rule: Every authentication branch added to or reordered inside a hook's `_get_token`/`_init_conn`/`get_conn` must come with a unit test that pins that branch - including the ambiguous case where several auth extras are set at once
clusters.trigger: A provider hook gains a new auth branch, or reorders existing auth if-branches, with no test covering that branch or the multi-extra precedence

clusters.rule: Do not commit compiled provider UI build output; `dist/` bundles must be produced by Breeze or at provider-package build time and be gitignored
clusters.trigger: Files under `providers/*/**/plugins/www/dist/` (`*.js`, `*.js.map`, `*.d.ts`) added in a diff

clusters.rule: Build Elasticsearch response fixtures with the existing `_build_es_search_response()` test helper rather than hand-rolling response dicts
clusters.trigger: A literal ES response dict such as `{"hits": {"total": ..., "hits": []}}` used as a mock return value in elasticsearch provider tests

clusters.rule: Write `AIRFLOW_CONN_*` environment-variable examples in Google provider docs in connection-URI form rather than as a JSON object literal
clusters.trigger: A provider `.rst` file contains `export AIRFLOW_CONN_<ID>='{...}'` with a JSON object literal

clusters.rule: Create mocks with `spec=`/`autospec=`/`mock.create_autospec()` when standing in for real Airflow objects - SQLAlchemy sessions, ORM instances, DAGs and operator methods - rather than bare `Mock()`/`MagicMock()`
clusters.trigger: `Mock()`/`MagicMock()` used for a session, role, permission or model object in a provider test, or `monkeypatch.setattr(DAG, "...", mock.MagicMock())` in task-SDK tests

clusters.rule: In Google hooks decorated with `@GoogleBaseHook.fallback_to_default_project_id`, document `project_id` as optional and place it last in the parameter list and docstring
clusters.trigger: A method with that decorator documents `project_id` as required or lists it before the other parameters

clusters.rule: When a docstring's `:param api_version:` example is bumped, update the versioned API documentation links in the same docstring to the matching version
clusters.trigger: A `:param api_version:` example changes (e.g. v4 to v5) while an official-API-docs link in the same class docstring still contains the old `/rest/v4/` path

clusters.rule: Collapse provider unit tests that differ only in one input and one expected value into a single `@pytest.mark.parametrize`d test
clusters.trigger: Two adjacent tests such as `test_x_with_<flag>` / `test_x_without_<flag>` with identical bodies apart from one argument and one assertion

clusters.rule: Tests must assert the behaviour a change produces, not that arguments were forwarded or internals were touched: for an error-suppression flag, give the mocked client a `side_effect` raising the real provider exception and assert nothing propagates
clusters.trigger: A test for `ignore_error=True`/soft-fail behaviour only asserts `<method>.assert_called_once_with(..., on_error=mock.ANY)` and never sets `side_effect`, or a test asserts only on `inspect.signature` or internal state the fix did not change

clusters.rule: Every public hook method added must gain a unit test that asserts the mocked client call chain arguments and the returned value, matching the pattern already used in that test module
clusters.trigger: A hook gains public methods while the corresponding `providers/*/tests/unit/.../test_<hook>.py` covers only some of them

clusters.rule: Tests for behaviour gated on an Airflow config flag must also exercise the flag-off state with `conf_vars`, asserting the legacy path is unchanged
clusters.trigger: Every new test wraps the call in `with conf_vars({("core", "multi_team"): "True"})` and none exercises the same call with the flag disabled

clusters.rule: Do not mutate `sys.modules` from a provider test package's `__init__.py`; install the stub with `monkeypatch.setitem` in a fixture scoped to the tests that need it
clusters.trigger: `sys.modules["..."] = ...` in a `tests/` package `__init__.py` rather than in a fixture or conftest

clusters.rule: Provider documentation examples for providers whose minimum Airflow version is 3 must use `schedule=` and import `PythonOperator` from `airflow.providers.standard.operators.python`
clusters.trigger: A provider README or docs example uses `schedule_interval=` or imports `PythonOperator` from `airflow.operators.python`

clusters.rule: A test for a polling-retry loop must assert the sleep mock's call count, not only the final result
clusters.trigger: A test patches `time.sleep` while exercising a polling retry loop but never asserts `mock_sleep.call_count`

clusters.rule: Documentation for the `_openlineage` DAG-run conf dict must state that all six parent and root ID fields should be provided together, and that omitting root information is discouraged for consumers supporting ParentRunFacet 1.1.0
clusters.trigger: Docs list the `_openlineage` parent/root fields as fully optional with no note about supplying all six

clusters.rule: New documentation added under `task-sdk/docs/` must be linked from the corresponding `airflow-core/docs/authoring-and-scheduling/` page
clusters.trigger: A new `.rst` file under `task-sdk/docs/` with no link or `toctree` entry from the core authoring docs

clusters.rule: New fields in task-SDK IPC message types must be covered by direct unit tests exercising both the populated and the absent/None case
clusters.trigger: A new field added to a `CommsDecoder` message type or `_RequestFrame` in `execution_time/comms.py` with no corresponding presence/absence tests under `task-sdk/tests/`

clusters.rule: When `__attrs_post_init__` normalises a field in place (e.g. resolving a preset alias to its canonical value), add an inline comment explaining the transformation and that `attrs.evolve`, equality and serialisation will see the resolved value
clusters.trigger: `self.<field> = <transform>(self.<field>)` inside `__attrs_post_init__` in a task-sdk attrs class with no explanatory comment

clusters.rule: Comment `force_flush(timeout_millis=...)` call sites to note that the value is an upper bound rather than a fixed wait
clusters.trigger: `provider.force_flush(timeout_millis=...)` added in task-SDK teardown with no explanatory comment

clusters.rule: Override Airflow configuration in tests with the `conf_vars` context manager rather than `unittest.mock.patch` on `conf.get`
clusters.trigger: `with patch("airflow.sdk.configuration.conf.get", ...)` or `patch("airflow.configuration.conf.get", ...)` in task-sdk tests

clusters.rule: Delete unused test helper functions instead of leaving them as dead code
clusters.trigger: A helper defined in a test module under `task-sdk/tests/` that no test in the file calls

clusters.rule: Guard tests that depend on POSIX `dup2` semantics with `pytest.mark.skipif(os.name == "nt", ...)`
clusters.trigger: `os.dup2(socket.fileno(), 0/1/2)` inside a test in `test_supervisor.py` with no platform guard

clusters.rule: Use a short `time.sleep` (2 seconds or less) in the signal-forwarding integration test DAG so the test exits on SIGTERM instead of waiting out the supervisor watchdog window
clusters.trigger: `time.sleep(N)` with N > 5 inside a test operator's `execute()` in `signal_forward_test.py`

clusters.rule: OTel span tests in the task SDK must assert parent/child span relationships, not merely that a span with the expected name was exported
clusters.trigger: A test asserts `"task.execute" in [s.name for s in exporter.get_finished_spans()]` without checking `span.parent.span_id`

clusters.rule: A task-SDK RPC helper's docstring must describe its own parameters and return value, not those of a sibling method it was copied from
clusters.trigger: A new `@staticmethod` in task_runner.py whose docstring names parameters or return values absent from its own signature

clusters.rule: `pytest.param` ids must describe the scenario they actually configure, including whether a parameter has a default
clusters.trigger: `pytest.param(..., id="...")` whose id claims a property (e.g. `without_default`) contradicted by the lambda/function signature in the same case

clusters.rule: When fixing a `KNOWN_CONTEXT_KEYS` decorator bug, add a regression case using the actual context key names from the report (`start_date`, `end_date`), not placeholder names
clusters.trigger: `test_construction_succeeds` parametrize cases added for a KNOWN_CONTEXT_KEYS fix with no case using real context key names
